description: This Java class defines the SubscriptionCreated event, which is emitted after establishing a stream for search results in the back-end. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and overrides for resource path and string representation.

classes.name: SubscriptionCreated
classes.description: Final class representing the subscription creation event, extending AbstractSubscriptionEvent, with methods for instantiation, JSON deserialization, and overrides for resource path and string conversion.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SubscriptionCreated instance with specified subscription ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SubscriptionCreated instance from a JSON object and headers, deserializing JSON content.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path, which is empty for this event.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new SubscriptionCreated instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: No payload to append; method is empty.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the class instance.
